input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

errors.what: second campaign (--seed 7) had a looping mutant at line 565 that ran to the 300 s timeout, pushing the foreground call into the background

doc_friction.issue: Step 0 asks to fix every open entry first, but all 11 are control-plane and already have owner-approval PRs waiting (#14612, #15945, #12926, #14698, #15561, #15728...). `redteam.py open` could print the waiting PR next to each so runs don't re-check them by search.

A suite that is 5 s per mutant can still blow the 300 s foreground limit when one mutant loops (default per-mutant timeout 300 s); suggest run_in_background for every campaign, or a --timeout of ~10x baseline by default.

real_defects.issue: describe() read negative BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO as 'on day last of the year', 'on day 366th from last of the year', 'in week last of the year'. Reproduced with describe(parseRule('FREQ=YEARLY;BYYEARDAY=-1')). Fixed: fromEnd() gives 'on the last day of the year', 'day 1 and the last day', 'in the 2nd from last week'.
A rule part with no name ('FREQ=DAILY;=WEEKLY') gave the error 'Unknown rule part ' with a blank name. Fixed: '"=WEEKLY" has no part name' (bad-part).

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id

certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
